description: Use when an agent needs a wallet balance or portfolio overview. The paid answer includes next_check: a ready call to wallet-changed ($0.001) that tells later whether the wallet changed. One wallet on one chain: native + top token balances, nonce, contract flag, recent token transfers. network: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, zksync, gnosis, celo or solana. Accepts ENS/Basenames. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

address.description: Wallet or contract address to report on (0x + 40 hex chars) or ENS/Basename (vitalik.eth, name.base.eth)

network.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, zksync, gnosis, celo or solana

name: wallet_report
title: Wallet report on Ethereum or Base: ETH and ERC-20 token balances, nonce and recent transfers in one call
